name: Turkey Shepherd's Pie with Carrots, Green Beans, Peas & Cheesy Potato Topping

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 stick celery
½ lb green beans

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice potatoes. Place in a large pot, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Trim and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl with the other veggies along with peas.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium yellow onion
1 cup frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, turkey, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until the turkey is cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, 7-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
butter, unsalted
1 lb ground turkey
1 tbsp garlic & herb seasoning
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the potatoes are done, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Add milk, butter, salt, and pepper, then using a potato masher, mash until smooth. Cover and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup whole milk
butter, unsalted
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are tender, add flour to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until well coated, about 1 minute.

Add broth and Worcestershire to the skillet, stir to combine the filling, then bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until gravy is thickened, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups chicken or vegetable broth
2 tsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: Transfer filling to a large baking dish, then top with mashed potatoes, spreading them out in an even layer. Sprinkle with cheese.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until filling is bubbling and cheese is melted, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide shepherd's pie between plates and enjoy!
